title: Value at a circuit gate
statement: Let $G$ be a finite list of Boolean gates and let $x$ be a Boolean input indexed by $0,ots,n-1$. If $j$ is less than the length of $G$ and every argument index of the $j$th gate is less than $n+j$, then the value at index $n+j$ in the list obtained by starting with $x$ and successively appending each gate’s value equals the evaluation of the $j$th gate on that resulting list.
